strategy.label: transcription from the report table, one amount calibrated with the input list fixed
strategy.note: Tab. 3.9/3.10 give every input; grid electricity was left free because the plant co-generates 183.8 kWh/t and the report does not say whether consumption is gross or net. The fit (fixed-list NNLS) put it at 2.5 kWh/t instead of the table's 68.6, i.e. the original nets its own generation. Hybrid node built on top.
